Blameless: contributing causes are systems and processes, never people. No information that could identify end users.

Required when any of these happened: user-visible downtime or degradation beyond the SLO threshold, any data loss, an on-call intervention (rollback, traffic rerouting), resolution time above threshold, or an incident found by a human instead of monitoring.
